# API

<!-- Generated by scripts/api-doc.mjs from packages/shared/openapi/openapi.json (pnpm api:types). Do not edit by hand. -->

IconBridge Jobs API, version 0.1.0: 120 operations. The interactive reference (Swagger UI) is at `/api/docs` on the API (<http://localhost:4000/api/docs> locally); in Azure the API has no public address, and the browser reaches it only through the web app under `/api/v1/*`.

## Conventions

- **Base path** `/api/v1`, JSON in and out (file uploads: `multipart/form-data`; exports: CSV or Excel). Health probes `/health/live` and `/health/ready` sit outside it.
- **Sessions**: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` sets two `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Lax` cookies: a 15-minute access token and a refresh token (`POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`). No bearer header.
- **Writes from a browser** must come from the site itself: a request whose `Origin` is another site is refused (CSRF origin check).
- **Validation**: every body, query and path parameter is checked with a zod schema of `packages/shared`; the typed client `@iconbridge/shared/api-client` is generated from this document.
- **Errors** always answer `{ code, message, details? }` with no stack trace. Rate-limited routes (sign-in, registration, forms) answer `429` with `RATE_LIMITED`.
- **Access** below comes from the guards themselves: _Public_ needs no session; _Signed in_ any role; otherwise only the roles listed (SPEC section 2). _Verified email_ also requires a confirmed address. Back-office routes live under `/api/v1/admin`.

Error codes: `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `FORBIDDEN`, `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `CONFLICT`, `EMAIL_TAKEN`, `INVALID_TOKEN`, `WEAK_PASSWORD`, `CAPTCHA_FAILED`, `LAST_SUPER_ADMIN`, `CANNOT_DISABLE_SELF`, `INVALID_JOB_TRANSITION`, `JOB_NOT_PUBLISHABLE`, `JOB_HAS_APPLICATIONS`, `UNSUPPORTED_FILE`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE`, `DOCUMENT_IN_USE`, `PROFILE_INCOMPLETE`, `PASSPORT_EXPIRED`, `JOB_NOT_OPEN`, `MAX_ACTIVE_APPLICATIONS`, `CANNOT_WITHDRAW`, `INVALID_APPLICATION_TRANSITION`, `NO_POSITION_LEFT`, `CONSENT_REQUIRED`, `IMAGE_REQUIRED`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `REAPPLY_COOLDOWN`, `UNDO_NOT_ALLOWED`, `COOLDOWN_WAIVER_NOT_ALLOWED`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`.

## Health

| Method | Path            | What                                      | Access |
| ------ | --------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------ |
| GET    | `/health/live`  | Liveness: the process is running          | Public |
| GET    | `/health/ready` | Readiness: the API can reach its database | Public |

## Public

| Method | Path                             | What                                                                          | Access |
| ------ | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| GET    | `/api/v1/jobs`                   | Search open jobs                                                              | Public |
| GET    | `/api/v1/jobs/{slug}`            | One open job, with its destination and category                               | Public |
| GET    | `/api/v1/destinations`           | Active destinations with their number of open jobs                            | Public |
| GET    | `/api/v1/categories`             | Active job categories with their number of open jobs                          | Public |
| GET    | `/api/v1/stats`                  | Counters of the home page                                                     | Public |
| GET    | `/api/v1/success-stories`        | Published success stories                                                     | Public |
| GET    | `/api/v1/home-slides`            | Active slides of the home page, in order                                      | Public |
| GET    | `/api/v1/site-info`              | Contact details and social links shown on the site, and the upload size limit | Public |
| POST   | `/api/v1/job-alerts`             | Subscribe to job alerts                                                       | Public |
| POST   | `/api/v1/job-alerts/confirm`     | Confirm a job alert with the token of the email link (valid 72 hours)         | Public |
| POST   | `/api/v1/job-alerts/unsubscribe` | Stop a job alert with the token of the unsubscribe link                       | Public |
| POST   | `/api/v1/contact`                | Contact form                                                                  | Public |

## Auth

| Method | Path                               | What                                                             | Access    |
| ------ | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| POST   | `/api/v1/auth/register`            | Create a candidate account                                       | Public    |
| POST   | `/api/v1/auth/verify-email`        | Confirm an email address with the token of the verification link | Public    |
| POST   | `/api/v1/auth/resend-verification` | Send the verification email again                                | Public    |
| POST   | `/api/v1/auth/login`               | Sign in                                                          | Public    |
| POST   | `/api/v1/auth/refresh`             | Get a new access token                                           | Public    |
| POST   | `/api/v1/auth/logout`              | Sign out: revokes the session and clears the cookies             | Public    |
| POST   | `/api/v1/auth/forgot-password`     | Send a password-reset link (valid 1 hour, usable once)           | Public    |
| POST   | `/api/v1/auth/reset-password`      | Set a new password                                               | Public    |
| GET    | `/api/v1/auth/session`             | Who is signed in, if anyone                                      | Public    |
| GET    | `/api/v1/auth/me`                  | The signed-in user                                               | Signed in |
